snippet.title: The Desktop Pinforge Demo is now available!
snippet.description:
A cyberpunk idle pinball game that lives directly on your desktop. Smash blocks, automate your build, upgrade your Reactor and Launcher, and turn a handful of bouncing orbs into a self-sustaining profit machine. Desktop Pinforge combines arcade pinball action with satisfying idle progression and a unique Desktop Mode experience. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}
